brief.headline: Musk plans SpaceX share for every U.S. child
brief.detail: SpaceX boss Elon Musk said Monday he'll give one of his company's shares to every U.S. child next year, without explaining how it would work.

brief.headline: Anthropic to deposit 5% of shares in public good fund
brief.detail: Anthropic plans to put 5% of its shares into a new fund for 'the public good', money that could be used to offset AI's impact on jobs.
